title: Bounded Systems content tokens
description: The contract for canonical brand copy and surface microcopy. Each token is a DTCG-style { $value, $description }, both non-empty. Tokens nest in DTCG groups: a surface's microcopy lives under its own namespace group (approve, clax, allie), flattened by consumers to dotted keys. Placeholders in a $value are {name}, filled by the surface. Mirrors tokens.json for the verbal layer.

$value.description: The canonical copy string presented on every surface. A {name} is a placeholder the surface fills; any other brace is an error.

$description.description: Where/how this string is used, and what each placeholder stands for.
